items.name: Linen Small Bed
items.blurb: A narrow bed made up in clean white linen.

items.name: Plank Bed
items.blurb: A plain single bed with a straw-coloured tick and a low wooden headboard.
items.collection: The Guest Room and Dressing Room

items.name: Pale Pine Chair
items.blurb: A slender chair of unstained pine, left bare as a carpenter's shop would display it.

items.name: Pale Plank Bench
items.blurb: A smooth plank seat on stout wooden legs, three feet of honest carpentry.

items.name: Tall-Backed Linen Chair
items.blurb: A slender chair with a high linen back and a white cushioned seat, plain enough for any hall.

items.name: Pewter Stew Pot
items.blurb: A big two-handled pewter pot, as good for a brew as for a stew and a great deal easier to carry than a cauldron.

items.name: Round Linen-Draped Table
items.blurb: A round table hidden under a gathered white cloth tied with ribbon, set for a feast or a wedding breakfast.

items.name: Rustic Plank Table
items.blurb: A long table of rough weathered planks on crossed legs, as served in a roadside inn.

items.name: Plain Olive Rug
items.blurb: A thick olive-green rug with a dark binding, the kind that hides a lot of muddy boots.

items.name: Welcome Mat
items.blurb: A white doormat with a plain WELCOME stitched in grey, laid just inside the threshold.

items.name: Amber Globe Lamp
items.blurb: A round globe of amber glass on a slim white stem, a simple lamp for a bedside or a writing desk.

items.name: Wrought Taper Stand
items.blurb: A twisted black-iron stem topped with one long taper, its wax running in golden streaks.

items.name: Brace of Old Books
items.blurb: Two old books, one russet and one gilt-edged, casually laid together.

items.name: Open Illuminated Tome
items.blurb: A great book lying open, its pages edged in gold and one corner of vellum curling up.

items.name: Pale Pine Shelves
items.blurb: A tall set of shelves in unstained pine, still smelling of fresh sawdust.

items.name: Blue Velvet Drape
items.blurb: The same heavy drape, dyed a rich ocean blue.

items.name: Green Velvet Drape
items.blurb: The same heavy drape, dyed a deep forest green.

items.name: Grey Patterned Vase
items.blurb: A big stoneware vase glazed grey and etched all round with a band of tiny patterns.

items.name: Large Clay Urn
items.blurb: A wide-bellied clay urn banded with shadows, big enough to hold a season's grain.

items.name: Marble Hourglass Stand
items.blurb: A tall hourglass of red sand in a gilded frame, set on a marble stand where all may watch their time run out.

items.name: Carved Rosewood Bed
items.blurb: A bed with a carved headboard crowned by turned posts and a footboard to match, dressed in pale linen.
items.collection: The Guest Room and Dressing Room

items.name: Elven Wash Basin
items.blurb: A washstand with a round white basin set in a pale carved top.
items.collection: The Guest Room and Dressing Room

items.name: Mahogany Chest of Drawers
items.blurb: A tall chest of drawers in dark mahogany, each drawer fitted with a brass pull.
items.collection: The Guest Room and Dressing Room

items.name: Cello on a Stand
items.blurb: A honey-gold cello resting on an iron stand, its bow laid across the strings.

items.name: Crimson Studded Armchair
items.blurb: A deep armchair in crimson leather, its tall back buttoned in rows of brass studs. The sort of seat a guildmaster keeps for guests.

items.name: Paneled Oak Armchair
items.blurb: A high-backed armchair of dark panelled oak, its tall back carved with recessed panels.

items.name: Ribboned Linen Chair
items.blurb: A light wooden chair dressed in white linen and tied with a bow at the back, as for a feast or a wedding.

items.name: Cast-Iron Stove
items.blurb: A squat black stove with a stove-pipe chimney, the kind a trapper hauls up to his winter cabin.

items.name: Cider and Ale Table
items.blurb: A plank table with a blue-glazed pitcher, jugs of cider and bottles of ale, the makings of a country evening.

items.name: Linen-Topped Table
items.blurb: A sturdy table topped with clean white linen, the kind a healer or tailor uses.

items.name: Pie Safe
items.blurb: A slate-topped cupboard with pierced tin doors that keep the pies safe from mice and flies.

items.name: Blue Bordered Rug
items.blurb: A deep blue rug edged with a pale blue pattern and fringed all round.

items.name: Crimson Runner
items.blurb: A plain crimson runner with a gold stripe and a tasselled fringe at each end.

items.name: Golden Hall Runner
items.blurb: A golden-brown runner with a dark border, long enough for a manor hallway.

items.name: Silk-Shaded Floor Lamp
items.blurb: A tall brass lamp on a round, ringed foot, glowing softly through a shade of pleated cream silk.

items.name: Songbird Globe Lamp
items.blurb: A sea-green glass globe held aloft on a curling stem, a little songbird perched on the leaves below.

items.name: Twin Blue-Glass Lamp
items.blurb: A pair of swan-necked arms bearing two bulbs of cool blue glass, rising from a fluted iron foot.

items.name: Heaped Stack of Books
items.blurb: A teetering heap of books in blue, rose and green, topped with a ribbon-bound folio.

items.name: Map of Moonglow
items.blurb: A map of Moonglow and its sea-wrapped island, with the scholars' tower marked in red.

items.name: Tall Stack of Books
items.blurb: A leaning tower of books in faded reds and blues, one good sneeze from collapse.

items.name: Gold-and-Green Floral Tapestry
items.blurb: Gold blossoms on a deep green ground, woven so closely the cloth seems to glow.

items.name: Midnight Blossom Tapestry
items.blurb: Pale blossoms drift across a ground as dark as a moonless night.

items.name: Round Painting of a Ship
items.blurb: An oval painting of a tall ship in full sail under a stormy sky, framed in dark wood and brass.

strictEraAlternate.name: Portrait of a Lady in Green

items.name: Canary Cage
items.blurb: A black iron cage holding a bright yellow canary that sings the morning in.

items.name: Hanging Staghorn Fern
items.blurb: A staghorn fern mounted on a board, its roots trailing and its fronds spread like antlers.

items.name: Oak Longcase Clock
items.blurb: A plain oak longcase clock with a brass pendulum, the sort of timepiece that outlives three generations of owners.

items.name: Linen Four-Poster Bed
items.blurb: A grand four-poster in carved brown wood, draped in crisp white linen with a fringed valance.

items.name: Mirrored Vanity
items.blurb: A small wooden dressing table with drawers and a round swivel mirror, loved by every lady in Britain.
items.collection: The Guest Room and Dressing Room

items.name: Blue and Gold Harp
items.blurb: A graceful harp strung in silver, its blue frame banded with gold.

items.name: High-Backed Oak Settle
items.blurb: A two-seat settle of dark panelled oak with a tall back, built to keep draughts off the fireside.

items.name: Long Velvet Sofa
items.blurb: A three-seat sofa in dark velvet, curved at one end like a swan's neck. Fit for a manor's long hall.

items.name: Cellarmaster's Table
items.blurb: A plank table lined with wine, ale and spirit bottles, the stock-in-trade of a good cellarmaster.

items.name: Plank-Top Dining Table
items.blurb: A three-by-two dining table with a smooth plank top, plain and strong.

items.name: Silver-Framed Wine Cabinet
items.blurb: A tall cabinet of silvered iron whose diamond racks hold green-glass bottles laid down to age.

items.name: Crimson Hall Runner
items.blurb: A long red runner with a thin gold border and a fringe at each end, for a lord's hall.

items.name: Golden Arabesque Carpet
items.blurb: A bright golden carpet worked with brown arabesque scrolls and a banded edge.

items.name: Orange Hearth Rug
items.blurb: A warm orange and brown carpet with a tasselled border, made for firelight.

items.name: Dragon-Wrapped Oil Lamp
items.blurb: A burnished-bronze dragon coiled around a glass bulb of lamp oil, its flame glowing amber inside.

items.name: Slate-Roofed Hearth
items.blurb: An open iron-posted hearth capped with a slab of grey slate, a steady fire glowing in its cage.

items.name: Apothecary Bookcase
items.blurb: A tall bookcase of red-brown wood crowded with tomes, with coloured flasks on the top shelf.

items.name: Scholar's Bookshelf and Mortar
items.blurb: A small bookshelf stacked with tomes, a pestle and mortar on top and a heap of red volumes at its foot.

items.name: Curtained Portrait
items.blurb: A gentleman's portrait framed between two long red drapes, like a window onto the past.

items.name: Portrait Between Sconces
items.blurb: A lady in crimson, lit from either side by a candle in an iron wall sconce.

items.name: Cobalt Spiral Urn
items.blurb: The great spiral urn in a deep cobalt glaze, with the white spiral standing out like a thumbprint in a pool.

items.name: Walnut Longcase Clock
items.blurb: A tall walnut clock, carved at the foot and the hood, ticking out the hours in a voice like a heartbeat.

items.name: White Orchid on a Stand
items.blurb: A spray of white orchids nodding over a wrought plant stand, a gift for a lady's solar.

items.name: Azure Carved Bed
items.blurb: The carved four-poster made up in a deep azure quilt, as if the sea had laid itself across the bed.

items.name: Crimson Canopied Bed
items.blurb: The same tall canopy bed in a deep crimson quilt, with enough pillows for a baron and his dreams.

items.name: Feather-Down Four-Poster
items.blurb: A four-poster dressed with a thick white eiderdown and plump pillows, as a duchess might insist.

items.name: Black Leather Sofa
items.blurb: A long sofa of black leather edged in polished copper, the kind of seat a master scholar sinks into with a heavy book.

items.name: Crimson Lacquer Harpsichord
items.blurb: A harpsichord in glossy crimson lacquer with a gilt-edged keyboard and a stool to match.

items.name: Four-Seat Settle
items.blurb: A long, high-backed settle for four, the sort of pew a guildmaster keeps beside the great hearth.

items.name: Candlelit Dinner Table
items.blurb: A long table laid for two, with a white runner, pewter cups, crimson napkins and a candle at each end.

items.name: Kitchen Pump Counter
items.blurb: A run of oak cupboards under a dark stone top, with a hand pump and deep basin set into the middle.

items.name: Long Banquet Table
items.blurb: A five-tile banquet table in polished oak, long enough to seat the whole guild at Midwinter.

items.name: Blue Floral Carpet
items.blurb: A large blue carpet scattered with coral blossoms and edged with a deep teal fringe.

items.name: Lunar Phases Rug
items.blurb: A great round rug of black wool ringed in gold, the moon passing through all its phases around a bronze compass-star.

items.name: Navy Medallion Carpet
items.blurb: A navy carpet with a great coral medallion at its heart and a double fringed border.

items.name: Gray Brick Fireplace
items.blurb: A tall chimney-breast of grey brick with a heavy oak mantel above a warm, blazing grate.

items.name: Stained-Glass Lamp
items.blurb: A table lamp with a leaded stained-glass shade in amber, violet and rose, glowing on a bronze foot.

items.name: Brass Telescope on Tripod
items.blurb: A long brass telescope on a three-legged stand of dark wood, aimed at the night sky or at a ship on the horizon.

items.name: Cartographer's Drafting Table
items.blurb: A tilting drafting table with a half-drawn chart pinned to the board and a pair of brass dividers laid across it.

items.name: Hall of Ancestors
items.blurb: Five generations of a proud family, frame to frame along a single wall.

items.name: Tapestry of Sosaria
items.blurb: A gold-bordered tapestry woven with a map of old Sosaria, the land that came before Britannia.

items.name: Velvet Gallery
items.blurb: Three ladies in green, gold and crimson, framed at either end by tall velvet drapes.

items.name: Ivory Longcase Clock
items.blurb: A white-lacquered longcase clock with a gilded face and a pendulum that glints in the lamplight.

items.name: Midnight Carved Bed
items.blurb: A carved oak bed under a quilt dyed the deep blue of the small hours.

items.name: Ebonwood Harpsichord and Bench
items.blurb: An ebonwood harpsichord with a long padded bench drawn up to the keys, set for a duet.

items.name: Gnarled Root Throne
items.blurb: A throne of twisted black roots that glow amber in the grain, with a seat of dark leather. A hermit-mage's whim.

items.name: Marble Banquet Table
items.blurb: A grand double marble table, cool and gleaming, for banquets that end in treaties.

items.name: Marble Bar with Sink
items.blurb: A marble-topped bar with a rinsing basin built into one end, so a barkeep need never leave the counter.

items.name: Slate Dragon Rug
items.blurb: A square slate-grey rug with a fretted border, across which a flame-red dragon unfurls its wings.

items.name: Gilded Marble Hearth
items.blurb: A small hearth of sand-gold marble, a flame dancing behind carved scrollwork and a gleaming trim.

items.name: Brass Orrery
items.blurb: A tiered brass orrery on a round marble-and-brass base, with golden worlds hung on arms about a bright centre.

items.name: Hall of the Eight Virtues
items.blurb: All eight virtue tapestries hung side by side in the order of the old teaching, a pilgrim's shrine wall.

items.name: Gilded Armillary Sphere
items.blurb: A sphere of gleaming gold rings, the kind of instrument that a royal astronomer would be forgiven for guarding with his life.

items.name: Great Hall Table
items.blurb: A vast two-by-five table of dark oak, the heart of any hall where lords are made to wait.

items.name: Great Hall Carpet
items.blurb: A huge russet carpet of tightly woven coral and orange patterns, for a hall where banquets run for days.

items.name: Fieldstone Home Hearth
items.blurb: A tall fieldstone chimney-breast with a log fire laid in the grate and a timber mantel above, the heart of a warm, lived-in house.

items.name: Grand Gallery
items.blurb: A gentleman, a gold-and-green tapestry and a lady in crimson, lit by sconces and framed by velvet drapes.
